_readme: Every user-facing string for the home page. JSON rather than TS on purpose: scripts/generate-brand-assets.mjs runs in plain Node and reads this same file, so the Open Graph card and the page cannot drift apart. Asset paths and layout live in src/data/mocks/home.ts. Add a sibling (ja.json) to translate; keys must match.
_stats_readme: hero.stats labels must stay unique: <HeroStats> keys its cards by label. The values are placeholders awaiting real figures — fill them in or drop the section rather than inventing numbers.

hero.headline: Beyond the leading
hero.body: FarEdge Labs builds software where the network runs out — edge devices, serverless backends, and the pipelines between them. We take the part of the problem that has no obvious answer yet.
